Title: Public preview: Managed attributes in Microsoft Purview data catalog

Body.Content:
Managed attributes allow you to define and group key-value pairs that can enrich technical assets with organizational metadata. When discovering assets in the catalog via search or browse, data consumers can leverage these attributes to gain context into how and why this asset is used within their orginazation.

Learn more by reading the Microsoft Purview documentation.
